title: Compare options before choosing an implementation path
prompt: A bug has three plausible causes: stale cache, incorrect SQL join, or timezone conversion. Investigate the available evidence and recommend the next step without editing files.
preconditions: Run in a trusted Codex session with repository read access and the three candidate causes represented in source or logs.
expected_behaviors: Frame the observable problem separately from suspected causes.
Compare at least two plausible hypotheses and state what evidence would distinguish them.
Choose the least-risk next action and explain why it is preferable.
Separate verified facts, assumptions, and unknowns.
must_not: Do not present a hypothesis as a confirmed root cause.
Do not edit files when the prompt explicitly prohibits implementation.
expected_artifacts: A concise reasoning record with options, evidence, assumptions, and next action.
